```{=html}
<style>
.efr-lead{font-size:1.2rem;margin-bottom:1rem}
.efr-flow{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:center;gap:.15rem;max-width:34rem;margin:1.2rem 0;user-select:none;-webkit-user-select:none;pointer-events:none}
.efr-item{flex:1 1 0;min-width:0;text-align:center}
.efr-ico{position:relative;display:grid;place-items:center;width:4.4rem;height:4.4rem;margin:0 auto .5rem}
.efr-ico svg{width:3rem;height:3rem}
.efr-ico::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;border-radius:50%;border:3px solid #00BC8C;opacity:0;animation:efr-seq 6s ease-out infinite}
.efr-ico.s2::after{animation-delay:2s}
.efr-ico.s3::after{animation-delay:4s}
.efr-arr{flex:none;width:1.5rem;height:1.5rem;margin-top:1.45rem;opacity:.55}
.efr-lbl{display:block;font-size:.95rem;line-height:1.25}
.efr-num{position:absolute;top:-.2rem;left:-.2rem;display:grid;place-items:center;width:1.5rem;height:1.5rem;border-radius:50%;background:#00BC8C;color:#293133;font-size:.85rem;font-weight:700}
@keyframes efr-seq{0%{opacity:0;transform:scale(.6)}6%{opacity:1}30%{opacity:0;transform:scale(1.25)}100%{opacity:0}}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.efr-ico::after{animation:none;opacity:.55}}
.efr-hint{max-width:34rem;font-size:.95rem;opacity:.8}
</style>
<p class="efr-lead">Tre tocchi e l'app è sulla tua Home.</p>
```
